# Sayod 111 Commercial Data Infrastructure

> Pure async HTTP/2 commercial intelligence engines, flat-schema Apify Actors, production n8n templates, and a Cloudflare Streamable HTTP MCP Gateway built by Sayed Ali (Sayod 111). Zero headless browsers, zero residential proxies, strict null integrity.

## Flagship Pure HTTP/2 Data Engines

The first four entries are product identifiers. Availability depends on the current Apify Store publication status. The healthcare and government Actors each returned 25 rows in verified cloud runs on November 25, 2026. Store publication is queued.
- [WealthPulse V3.5: SEC Form ADV & RIA Wealth Intelligence](https://apify.com/sayod111/sec-ria-wealthpulse): 25 ranked California rows returned in 3.943 seconds from a feed of 24,124 U.S. SEC filings, with 45 flat columns ($15/1K, weekly AUM diff, client segments, verified Item 11 disclosures, custody, clean domains).
- [SaaS Trust Center, SOC 2 & AI Subprocessor Audit](https://apify.com/sayod111/saas-trust-center-audit): Bulk DNS + HTTP/2 auditor for Vanta, Drata, SafeBase, Secureframe, AI subprocessors, IAM/SSO, and RFC 9116 security.txt ($15/1K, 22 flat columns).
- [US Healthcare KOL & NPI Enricher: CMS Payments + Medicare](https://apify.com/sayod111/us-healthcare-kol-cms-enricher): Keyless 3-way federal join across CMS NPPES NPI Registry, CMS Open Payments (Sunshine Act), and CMS Medicare Part B + Revocations ($12/1K, 22 flat columns).
- [US SLED Government Bids & RFP Monitor](https://apify.com/sayod111/us-sled-gov-bids-monitor): Unified state and municipal RFP/bid feed across 30+ Bonfire PublicPortal agencies and NYC City Record Procurement Socrata API ($8/1K, 22 flat columns).
- [Shopify Tech Stack, Klaviyo & Ad Pixel Auditor](https://apify.com/sayod111/shopify-klaviyo-pixel-auditor): 85+ apps, Klaviyo retention gaps, and exact Meta/TikTok/Google pixel IDs ($8/1K).
- [Bulk Domain DMARC, SPF & MX Security Auditor](https://apify.com/sayod111/dmarc-spf-mx-deliverability-auditor): Live DNS email security and deliverability checks for MSPs ($5/1K).
- [B2B Revenue Intelligence (97-Field Enricher)](https://apify.com/sayod111/b2b-revenue-lead-enricher-mcp): 97 flat ICP columns per domain combining 110+ tech fingerprints, DNS security, and corporate contacts ($5/1K).
- [B2B Hiring Intent 7-ATS Scanner](https://apify.com/sayod111/b2b-hiring-intent-ats-mcp): Open roles and 6 buying-intent triggers across 7 ATS career boards ($4/1K).
- [CommercePulse Pro](https://apify.com/sayod111/commercepulse-pro): Multi-platform e-commerce storefront auditor across Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento, PrestaShop, Salla, and Zid ($3/1K).

## Measured Cloud Efficiency
- Strictly flat snake_case schemas reduce a 12-step Clay table from 12,000 Actions down to 1,000 Actions per 1,000 rows (91.7% savings).
- Verified Apify Cloud platform cost: $0.0114 per 1,000 rows for WealthPulse V3.5 and $0.0455 per 1,000 domains for Trust Center Audit, with zero residential proxies.
- Limited permissions enabled across all Actors for MCP compatibility and x402 agentic readiness.
